race.comment: BOURNE LEGACY (1) was runner-up when resuming at Kyneton as the favourite, then was fourth in a harder field there last time out. The blinkers are back on for his peak run, and he should go close to taking this out. PRINCE OF GLAM (4) won a trial here before failing to finish his run off on debut at Albury 3 weeks ago in a 50K maiden. The winkers are on, and he can be a sharp improver. BORATA'S GIRL (6) overcame a wide draw when sustaining a long run from the back to finish second fresh up at Gundagai nearly 2 weeks ago on a heavy track. She has the scope to pick up a win at short notice. MAGNA PEAK (7) did nothing on debut at Swan Hill after showing promise at the jump-outs before that. She has a good gate, and is worth including this time. TOUGH REVELATION (5) has continued to improve at the ump-outs, and he is in good hands for his debut. Follow any market support.
